item.title: [7.0] Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation.

WHY IT MATTERS

Jeveration introduces a novel single-pass parallel generation paradigm using frozen vision-language models, though its practical impact over diffusion models remains to be proven.

item.title: [6.6] AVTR: Adaptive Multimodal Reasoning with Visual Imagination
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Vision-Language Models increasingly rely on textual reasoning to solve advanced multimodal tasks. Despite its effectiveness, this paradigm faces two fundamental limitations. First, relying on textual reasoning alone can limit perceptual ability in vision-centric questions, where accurate answers depend on interpreting task-relevant visual evidence.

WHY IT MATTERS

AVTR introduces a novel adaptive routing mechanism between visual imagination and textual reasoning for multimodal models, moving beyond uniform text-heavy inference traces.
